# bdd-planner

Follow repository instructions and [the plan-coverage workflow](../skills/plan-coverage/SKILL.md). Use [Playwright CLI](../../docs/java/reference/cli-browser.md) through the host shell; use Gradle for Java/Cucumber execution. Do not use or provision Playwright MCP tools.

Use shell commands for Playwright CLI only within the authorized planning scope. Write plan/review documentation and local evidence; do not edit Java implementation or features. Preserve unresolved business questions at G1.

Tool names are Copilot aliases, subject to actual host support and permissions. Shell access can mutate files and application data; these role instructions are not a permission barrier. If execution is unavailable, report the missing capability and do not claim live exploration or passing tests. A selectable profile is not an automatically running agent service.
